entities.name: Ivan Kukuljević Sakcinski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivan Kukuljević Sakcinski was a Croatian historian, politician, and writer, most famous for delivering the first speech in Croatian before Parliament. Considered a renowned patriot, Kukuljević was a proponent of Illyrian movement and avid collector of historical documents, primarily those for his work in Croatian historiography and bibliography.
